title: Pure Toon
summary: Pure Toon build with Cartoon Shade, The Black Stone of Legend, and generic staples. Toon Kingdom counts as Toon World on the field, makes your Toon monsters untargetable and indestructible, and lets your Toons attack directly while the opponent controls no Toon monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Toon Table of Contents searches any Toon card without a once-per-turn limit, chaining through copies of itself into Toon Bookmark, which searches Toon Kingdom or any card that mentions Toon World.
The Black Stone of Legend Tributes itself to Special Summon Red-Eyes Toon Dragon directly from the Deck, which then Special Summons any Toon monster from your hand ignoring its summoning conditions.

Cartoon Shade Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set (such as Red-Eyes Toon Dragon, Toon Dark Magician Girl, or Toon Mermaid), and searches a Level 5 or higher monster that mentions Toon World (Toon Dark Magician Girl).

summary.title: Opening: The Black Stone of Legend + Toon Bookmark
steps: Activate Toon Bookmark to search Toon Kingdom, then activate Toon Kingdom by banishing 3 cards from the top of your Deck face-down.
Normal Summon The Black Stone of Legend and Tribute it to Special Summon Red-Eyes Toon Dragon from the Deck.

Use Red-Eyes Toon Dragon to Special Summon Toon Dark Magician from the hand, then discard a Toon card with Toon Dark Magician to Special Summon Toon Black Luster Soldier from the Deck or search Toon Terror or Comic Hand.

summary.title: Cartoon Shade & Tribute Toons
summary.text: Cartoon Shade bridges the classic Tribute-based Toons into the modern engine. Because Red-Eyes Toon Dragon, Toon Mermaid, and Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon cannot be Normal Summoned/Set, Cartoon Shade Special Summons itself alongside them and searches Toon Dark Magician Girl. Tributing Cartoon Shade to Special Summon Toon Dark Magician Girl (which can attack the turn it is summoned), Toon Black Luster Soldier, or Toon Summoned Skull triggers Cartoon Shade in the GY to bounce up to 2 cards on the field to the hand.

summary.title: Bosses & Direct Attackers
points: Toon Black Luster Soldier Special Summons itself from the hand by Tributing Toon monsters totaling Level 8 or higher (or via Toon Page-Flip and Toon Dark Magician), can attack directly with Toon World on the field, and banishes 1 card on the field each turn.
Toon Dark Magician discards a Toon card to either Special Summon any Toon monster from the Deck ignoring its summoning conditions or search any Toon Spell/Trap.

Toon Harpie Lady Special Summons itself while you control Toon World and destroys a Spell/Trap if you control another Toon; Toon Cyber Dragon, Toon Mermaid, and Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon provide additional bodies and direct-attack pressure.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Toon Kingdom becomes Toon World on the field, prevents the opponent from targeting your Toon monsters with card effects, and banishes 1 card from the top of your Deck face-down whenever a Toon monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect; Toon Bookmark in the GY can banish itself to protect Toon World from destruction.
Toon Page-Flip reveals 3 Toon monsters with different names from your Deck and Special Summons 1 at random ignoring its summoning conditions.

Comic Hand steals an opponent's monster while you control Toon World, turning it into a Toon monster that can attack directly, and Toon Terror is an omni-negate Counter Trap while you control both Toon World and a Toon monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's older combo lines that splash Synchron, Charmer, Horned Saurus, Kaitoptera, and Sorcerer of the Swamp engines are omitted to keep the list pure, and Toon World the Perfect World is OCG-only.
